seo.title: Contact — Cedar Mill Plumbing · Mike Hollister
seo.description: Request a service call or estimate from Cedar Mill Plumbing — licensed Oregon plumber serving Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and NW Portland. Direct line: (503) 555-0149.

header.heading: Request a service call or free estimate.
header.lead: Send a short note — what's going on with the plumbing, where the house is, and how soon you need someone out. I respond personally, usually within a few hours during business hours and same-day on evenings/weekends. If it's a true emergency (active leak, mainline backup, no hot water tonight), call instead — (503) 555-0149.

infoCards.title: Call Direct
infoCards.body: Phone is the fastest way for service calls and emergencies. Goes straight to Mike, including evenings and weekends.

infoCards.title: Response Time
infoCards.body: Form replies usually within a few hours during business days. Non-emergency service calls scheduled inside 3 to 5 business days. Emergency dispatch 24/7 in the service area.

infoCards.title: Active Emergency?
infoCards.body: Burst pipe, sewage backup, no hot water tonight, gas smell — call (503) 555-0149 directly. The form is checked during business hours; the phone is checked 24/7. If it's life-safety (fire, structural, gas you can smell from outside), call 911 first.

expect.heading: What to expect
items: A real reply from Mike, not an auto-responder
An honest read on whether it's a flat-rate service call or worth an estimate visit
Scheduling options that match the urgency you flagged
Photos and a written invoice with every job — that part starts at the first visit
